title: RLS policies for multi-tenant advisor isolation and Google OAuth domain restriction
description: Enforce row-level security across all lead-facing tables keyed on asesor_asignado (contacts/leads) matching the authenticated user's sales record. Three roles: admin (read all, write all), manager (read own + team, write within team), asesor (read own leads only, write advisor-owned fields only). Also configure Google OAuth to restrict sign-in to @inmovel.net domain. The existing canAccess pattern in the FakeRest authProvider is extended to support the three roles. supabase/schemas/05_policies.sql is the main deliverable.
acceptance_criteria: supabase/schemas/05_policies.sql adds RLS policies on the contacts (leads) table: admin can SELECT/UPDATE/INSERT all rows; manager can SELECT rows where asesor_asignado is themselves or a sales row whose manager_id is the manager's sales.id (team scope is modeled by sales.manager_id, added in TASK-007); asesor can SELECT only rows where asesor_asignado = auth.uid()-matched sales.id
supabase/schemas/05_policies.sql adds RLS on visitas: asesor can INSERT/SELECT their own lead's visitas; no asesor UPDATE/DELETE
supabase/schemas/05_policies.sql adds SELECT-only policy on conversaciones, anuncios, propiedades for all authenticated users

supabase/schemas/05_policies.sql restricts UPDATE on contacts.stage to: stages S1-S5 are never writable by any CRM role (enforced via a policy check: NEW.stage NOT IN ('S1','S2','S3','S4','S5') OR OLD.stage = NEW.stage); this is the DB-level guard complementing the UI guard in TASK-009
supabase/schemas/05_policies.sql grants admin/manager the ability to set stage=S10 Cierre
supabase/functions/users/index.ts or Supabase Auth config enforces domain restriction: only emails matching @inmovel.net are allowed to sign up / sign in via Google OAuth
src/components/atomic-crm/providers/commons/canAccess.ts updated to resolve permissions for roles admin, manager, asesor against a role claim stored in user JWT metadata (app_metadata.role)
src/components/atomic-crm/providers/fakerest/authProvider.ts sets app_metadata.role for fake users to enable local dev testing of all three roles

non_functional_requirements.performance: RLS policies use index on contacts.asesor_asignado; policy evaluation adds <5ms overhead
non_functional_requirements.security: No row is readable by an asesor not assigned to it; the stage S1-S5 write-lock is enforced at the DB layer independently of the UI
non_functional_requirements.scalability: Manager team-scope query joins sales on manager_id (no separate teams table) — keep the join lightweight
